sent_bad: Based on `doc.txt`, a new device starts in its default settings: standard 'right-handed' mode, the lowest cursor speed, standard 'right-click' mode, and the buzzer on.
A new unit is already in the standard mode — "One beep indicates the unit is set to standard 'right-handed' mode, whereas two beeps indicates 'left-handed' operation" (doc.txt).
Since it is already right-handed, no button press is needed (pressing the left button would switch it to left-handed).

Starting from the lowest speed, one brief press of the middle button is needed, and "Each time you do so, the unit emits a number of beeps, between 1 and 4. One beep indicates the lowest speed and 4 the highest" (doc.txt) — so speed 2 gives 2 beeps.
